original_work: Room arrangement, damage placement, material assembly, lighting, camera setup, clothing tint, body fitting, physical fixture proxies and video graphics authored for this project.

sources.name: StampFly ecosystem airframe geometry
sources.included: 13 original STL parts in assets/civic_world/physics and the same geometry within the packed .blend
sources.modifications: Metric scale, materials and placement; proposed camera/flow/feet are separately authored schematic additions.

sources.name: MakeHuman base and core assets
sources.included: Fitted body, male_casualsuit05 clothing, shoes01, short02/bob01 hair, high-poly eyes and skin/eye/hair/clothing textures packed in the .blend
sources.modifications: Body scale and relaxed arm pose, clothing fitting and blue/red tint. The base.obj header explicitly records its September 2020 CC0 release.

sources.name: Poly Haven material scans
sources.included: 2K diffuse and roughness textures packed into the .blend; downloaded channels and hashes are recorded in assets/civic_sources/sources.json
sources.modifications: Projection scale, roughness, tint and procedural surface relief.

fonts: Installed Windows fonts are used to rasterize video titles. Font files are not included.
audio: Final video: OpenAI generated narration and original procedural music; voice and font files are not included
